name: Operation Iraqi Freedom
explanation: The 2006 Iraq deployment with Combined Joint Task Force Troy, about six months. The campaign phase recorded on Signum is National Resolution. That phase is the first bronze star on the Iraq Campaign Medal (each phase is a star; no bare ribbon).

name: Operation Iraqi Freedom
explanation: Individual-augmentee tour that started in October 2008. Five months at Fort Bliss, then 7 months in country at Joint Base Balad. In theater: Task Force Iron Shield. Admin: 11th ADA. Partner: 3-3 ADA. Customer: 332nd Air Expeditionary Wing at Joint Base Balad. The campaign phase recorded on Signum is Iraq Sovereignty. This is the second bronze star on the Iraq Campaign Medal (each phase is a star; no bare ribbon).

name: Operation Enduring Freedom
explanation: Afghanistan deployment of about seven months. Assigned to JCSE. In theater: CJSOTF-A. Customer: ODA 3213, 3rd Special Forces Group, at FOB Delaram. This phase is the first bronze star on the Afghanistan Campaign Medal (each phase is a star; no bare ribbon).

name: Operation Enduring Freedom
explanation: A second Afghanistan deployment of about seven months, from Joint Communications Support Element. In theater: SOJTF-A. Partner: 290th JCSS. Customer: 75th Ranger Regiment, at FOB Orgun-E. The NATO Medal for ISAF is dated 2013 on the worksheet. This phase is the second bronze star on the Afghanistan Campaign Medal.
